messages.author: 8c519738a4c17530
messages.subject: 'Repeatable example' link...
parts:
Periodically, I think to myself, "I know Hadley's got superb
instructions for building a concise repeatable example. Where did I
see them?"

I found it in the archives, eventually, and am looking at the github
link.

Would it be silly to have a link to that page from the ggplot2 front
page?


- Allen S. Rout

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: 'Repeatable example' link...
parts:
Hi Allen,

It's probably a good idea, but judging from past experience people
won't read it unless prompted. I probably need to do a better job of
encouraging people to read that link when I ask for a reproducible
example.

Hadley
